design_vision: A neo-brutalist take on Amazon tailored for students. It prioritizes function, high contrast, and raw energy. The interface uses a stark black and light yellow color palette, employing harsh borders, prominent typography, and highly visible interactive elements to create a trustworthy, fast-moving marketplace vibe.

typography.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter uppercase
typography.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight uppercase

header.style: bg-white border-b-4 border-black py-4 sticky top-0 z-50
header.search_bar: border-2 border-black bg-white rounded-none px-4 py-2 focus:ring-0 focus:outline-none focus:bg-yellow-50 shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)]
header.cta: bg-black text-white px-6 py-2 font-bold uppercase hover:bg-yellow-400 hover:text-black transition-colors

card.style: bg-white border-2 border-black shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] hover:shadow-[8px_8px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-200 p-4 flex flex-col gap-4
card.title: font-heading font-bold text-xl truncate
card.price: text-2xl font-black bg-yellow-300 inline-block px-2 border-2 border-black

button.primary: bg-yellow-400 text-black border-2 border-black shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[6px_6px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] active:translate-y-1 active:shadow-none transition-all px-8 py-3 font-bold uppercase
button.secondary: bg-white text-black border-2 border-black shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[6px_6px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] active:translate-y-1 active:shadow-none transition-all px-8 py-3 font-bold uppercase

animations.marquee: slow continuous slide for categories or announcements

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Phosphor icons for a thick, bold look (weight='bold' or 'fill').
Do not use generic gray borders; use solid black (#000000) for all component borders.
Implement the brutalist shadow effect using Tailwind's arbitrary values: shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)]. When hovering, increase offset to 8px. When active, reduce to 0px.
Headings must use 'Clash Display'. Add this to your HTML head or import via CSS. Body font should be 'IBM Plex Sans'.
Every interactive element must have the 'data-testid' attribute.
For the Buy/Sell toggle, use a massive, pill-like or blocky toggle switch prominently in the header or hero section.
Ensure input fields don't have rounded corners. Use rounded-none for a sharp, edgy feel.
The admin dashboard should follow the same brutalist theme but utilize a denser grid layout.
For chat UI, use high-contrast text bubbles (black bg with white text vs white bg with black text and thick borders).
All cards must have white backgrounds to contrast against the light yellow page background.
